run_debug_share: run the hermes debug share command to upload a debug report with system info and log tails to a paste service
run_debug_delete: run the hermes debug delete command to remove a previously uploaded paste from paste.rs
upload_to_pastebin: upload text content to a paste service using paste.rs with dpaste.com as fallback
collect_debug_report: collect a debug report combining system dump output with recent log file tails
delete_paste: delete a paste from paste.rs using its URL via an unauthenticated DELETE request
